Actually, let me reconsider. Let me look at the `hb_face_create` flow. When `data` offset is 0, `data_base = &(this+data)` = null pool. But wait, during sanitize, does the sanitize actually fail?

Let me trace through the sanitize more carefully with `data` offset = 0.

`ResourceForkHeader::sanitize`:
```cpp
return_trace (c->check_struct (this) &&
              data.sanitize (c, this, dataLen) &&
              map.sanitize (c, this, &(this+data)));
```

`c->check_struct(this)` - checks the ResourceForkHeader (16 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.

`data.sanitize(c, this, dataLen)`:
```cpp
template <typename T1>
inline bool sanitize (hb_sanitize_context_t *c, const void *base, T1 d1) const
{
  return_trace (sanitize_shallow (c, base) &&
                (this->is_null () ||
                 StructAtOffset<Type> (base, *this).sanitize (c, d1) ||
                 neuter (c)));
}
```

`sanitize_shallow(c, base)`:
```cpp
if (unlikely (!c->check_struct (this))) return_trace (false);
if (unlikely (this->is_null ())) return_trace (true);
if (unlikely (!c->check_range (base, *this))) return_trace (false);
return_trace (true);
```

`c->check_struct(this)` - checks the `data` offset field (4 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.
`this->is_null()` - `data` offset is 0, has_null=true. Returns true. So `sanitize_shallow` returns true.

So `data.sanitize` returns true (because `this->is_null()` is true, short-circuiting the `&&`).

`map.sanitize(c, this, &(this+data))`:
`data_base = &(this+data)`. `data` offset is 0, has_null=true. So `&(this+data)` = null pool. `data_base` = null pool.

`map.sanitize(c, this, data_base)`:
```cpp
template <typename T1>
inline bool sanitize (hb_sanitize_context_t *c, const void *base, T1 d1) const
{
  return_trace (sanitize_shallow (c, base) &&
                (this->is_null () ||
                 StructAtOffset<Type> (base, *this).sanitize (c, d1) ||
                 neuter (c)));
}
```

`sanitize_shallow(c, base)`:
- `c->check_struct(this)` - checks the `map` offset field (4 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.
- `this->is_null()` - `map` offset. If `map` offset is NOT 0, returns false.
- `c->check_range(base, *this)` - checks `this + map_offset` is in the blob. If `map` offset is valid, passes.

So `sanitize_shallow` returns true (assuming `map` offset is valid).

`this->is_null()` - `map` offset is not 0, so false. So we proceed to `StructAtOffset<ResourceMap>(base, *this).sanitize(c, data_base)`.

`StructAtOffset<ResourceMap>(base, *this)` = `(ResourceMap*)((char*)this + map_offset)`. This is the ResourceMap in the blob.

`ResourceMap::sanitize(c, data_base)`:
```cpp
const void *type_base = &(this+typeList);
return_trace (c->check_struct (this) &&
              typeList.sanitize (c, this, type_base, data_base));
```

`c->check_struct(this)` - checks the ResourceMap (28 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.

`type_base = &(this+typeList)`. If `typeList` offset is valid (not 0), `type_base` is in the blob.

`typeList.sanitize(c, this, type_base, data_base)`:
```cpp
template <typename T1, typename T2>
inline bool sanitize (hb_sanitize_context_t *c, const void *base, T1 d1, T2 d2) const
{
  return_trace (sanitize_shallow (c, base) &&
                (this->is_null () ||
                 StructAtOffset<Type> (base, *this).sanitize (c, d1, d2) ||
                 neuter (c)));
}
```

`sanitize_shallow(c, base)`:
- `c->check_struct(this)` - checks the `typeList` offset field (2 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.
- `this->is_null()` - `typeList` offset. If not 0, false.
- `c->check_range(base, *this)` - checks `this + typeList_offset` is in the blob. Passes.

So `sanitize_shallow` returns true.

`this->is_null()` - `typeList` offset not 0, so false. Proceed to `StructAtOffset<ArrayOfM1<ResourceTypeRecord>>(base, *this).sanitize(c, type_base, data_base)`.

`ArrayOfM1<ResourceTypeRecord>::sanitize(c, type_base, data_base)`:
```cpp
template <typename T>
inline bool sanitize (hb_sanitize_context_t *c, const void *base, T user_data) const
{
  TRACE_SANITIZE (this);
  if (unlikely (!sanitize_shallow (c))) return_trace (false);
  unsigned int count = lenM1 + 1;
  for (unsigned int i = 0; i < count; i++)
    if (unlikely (!arrayZ[i].sanitize (c, base, user_data)))
      return_trace (false);
  return_trace (true);
}
```

`sanitize_shallow(c)`:
```cpp
return_trace (lenP1.sanitize (c) &&
              (!lenP1 || c->check_array (arrayZ, lenP1 - 1)));
```
